mentions.name: wezmux
mentions.description: A cmux-like sidebar for a fork of the WezTerm terminal emulator that surfaces Claude Code and Codex notifications and output previews, without adding a web browser to the terminal.
mentions.problem: The author experienced font and scrolling problems with cmux and didn't want a web browser built into their terminal, so they built the sidebar into WezTerm instead to get Claude Code / Codex notifications and output previews.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I built a cmux-like sidebar for a fork of wezterm, called wezmux https://github.com/vcabeli/wezmux

If you know, you know. I wanted to like cmux but I had tons of problem with fonts or scrolling behaviors and I don't need a web browser in my terminal, so I went back to wezterm and added the nice sidebar for my claude code / codex notifications and output previews.
